description: Knowledge base for identifying a replaceable transformer encoder layer by forward structural evidence (no class-name matching). First-version scope: standard serial Pre-LN / Post-LN transformer (2 norm + 2 residual + 1 attn + 1 FFN). Family extension (Parallel / GAU single-norm topologies, cnn/rnn/moe blocks) adds new pattern JSON files alongside this one (OCP).

attention.non_standard_fallback: When matmul(Q, K^T) is not directly observable (linear attention reorders matmul(K, V) before Q; SOFTS-style attention_matrix_applied_to_value), accept the indirect evidence output = matmul(<seq-mix matrix>, value_proj(x)) — a trainable or computable seq-mixing matrix applied to the value projection.

ffn.note: Linear -> activation -> Linear dominant. activation ∈ {relu, gelu, silu, ...}. Non-standard FFN structures (bypass / GLU / dual) are recorded but do not change layer kind.

evidence_concrete_examples: Post-LN: forward = attn(src) -> norm1(x + dropout(attn_out)) -> ffn -> norm2(x + dropout(ffn_out))
Pre-LN: forward = x + attn(norm1(x)) -> x + ffn(norm2(x))

field_extraction_rules.num_heads: Read from the layer's attention submodule constructor (e.g. nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim, num_heads) -> read num_heads).
field_extraction_rules.head_dim: embed_dim / num_heads (computed); record the per-head dimension.
field_extraction_rules.original_intermediate: Read from the FFN submodule's first Linear out_features (the intermediate expansion dimension).
field_extraction_rules.activation: Read the activation module used between the two FFN Linears (relu / gelu / silu / ...). Verbatim from source.
field_extraction_rules.norm_type: layernorm / rmsnorm / ... — the layer's norm module type. Source-of-record only (does not drive variant selection — first-version variants are uniformly Pre-LN with nn.LayerNorm per design L14).
field_extraction_rules.max_seq_len: Leave -1 in the declaration; pz_baseline traces the real input sequence length at runtime and writes it back. Forbidden to fallback to a constant (e.g. 512) — a fallback over-parameterizes the mixing matrix for short-sequence projects and breaks BLD optimization (the hardcoded-512 case for a seq=16 project allocates a 2.6M-parameter matrix where the real mixer needs ~16 entries).
field_extraction_rules.mask_load_bearing: pz_baseline traces at runtime whether src_mask / attn_mask actually received a non-None value. Leave false in the declaration; signature presence of a mask kwarg alone is not load-bearing (design L13).

reject_when: Pure attention submodule with no FFN (do not enter slots — this is a sub-block, not a layer).
Pure FFN submodule with no attention (same — sub-block).

Single-norm topology: Parallel residual (FlashFormer / GPT-J style `x = x + attn(l) + ffn(l)` sharing one norm) or GAU (Gated Attention Unit, single norm + gate). First version does not support these — leave slots: [] and emit model_type_supported=false. Family extension adds parallel_block / gau_block layouts here (OCP).

candidate_contract.identity_mandatory: Every transformer_layer slot's candidate list must contain `identity` (preserve the father-loaded layer — MIP floor anchor).
candidate_contract.catalog_reference: $ORCA_WORKFLOWS_ROOT/agents/_puzzle_scripts/candidate_catalog.yaml registers builtin layer variants (vanilla_layer / random_synthesizer_layer / relu_attention_layer / fnet_layer / softs_star_layer / no_op_layer). User-registered candidates use {name, factory, applies_to, params} with factory = `<file>::<callable>`.
candidate_contract.mask_handling: Layer-variant forward uniformly accepts mask via _extract_mask (positional / attn_mask / src_mask / attention_mask / mask / key_padding_mask). vanilla_layer truly uses attn_mask (nn.MultiheadAttention); score-less mixers (fnet / random_synthesizer / relu_attention / softs_star) accept but ignore. mask_load_bearing is runtime-traced, not signature-static (design L13).

layer_evidence_required: Each slot carries a `layer_evidence` string filled from `evidence_template` with concrete structural facts observed in this layer's forward (Pre-LN vs Post-LN, attn mechanism, FFN activation, norm/residual counts). Class names are not evidence — structural facts are.
